expected_issues.title: Body read is capped at the buffer size instead of the requested maximum
expected_issues.description:
The read loop is capped at the internal buffer size instead of the requested maximum, so bodies larger than one buffer are silently truncated.

readToByteBuffer(max) now starts with `remaining = bufferSize` and stops once `remaining` bytes have been read. When the caller asks for a max larger than the buffer (e.g. the default body size limit), only the first buffer-full of the stream is returned and the rest of the document is dropped without error. The cap must be based on `max`, not `bufferSize`.
